baseline_design_vector.description: Validated baseline configuration from V4 campaign

fuel_radius_cm.description: Fuel pellet radius controlling fuel volume, power density, and clad heat flux.

cladding_thickness_cm.description: Nb-1Zr clad wall thickness controlling structural creep margin and thermal resistance.

coolant_gap_cm.description: Annular coolant gap width determining flow area, velocity, Re, and friction pressure drop.

pin_pitch_cm.description: Hexagonal lattice pitch controlling moderator volume fraction and core diameter.

active_core_height_cm.description: Active core fuel stack height affecting aspect ratio L/D and axial leakage.

radial_reflector_thickness_cm.description: BeO radial reflector thickness balancing neutron reflection and mass.

mass_flow_multiplier.description: Mass flow multiplier adjusting coolant temperature rise and heat transfer coefficient.

inlet_temperature_K.description: Recuperator return temperature entering the reactor lower plenum.

inner_enrichment_wt.description: HALEU enrichment in central 19 pins (Rings 0-2) for radial power flattening.

orificing_mode.description: Inlet orifice loss distribution across rings 0 to 8 to equalize exit coolant temperatures.

C01_max_cladding_temp.source: Touloukian (1970), Nb-1Zr thermal creep acceleration limit (~1077 °C)
C01_max_cladding_temp.description: Operating above 1350 K induces rapid tertiary creep rupture over 10-20 years.

C02_max_fuel_temp.source: Hayes et al. (1990), UN melting point 3035 K; 1800 K avoids significant fission gas release
C02_max_fuel_temp.description: Maintains >1200 K margin to UN melting and keeps FGR below 1%.

C03_core_pressure_drop.parameter: Core Total Coolant Pressure Drop (Delta P)
C03_core_pressure_drop.source: Galloway et al. (2004) AIAA-2004-5977, CBC pressure ratio allocation (Delta P/P < 1.4%)
C03_core_pressure_drop.description: Prevents excessive compressor pumping work degradation.

C04_subassembly_mass.source: Opt-17 Project Specification / Launch Payload Envelope
C04_subassembly_mass.description: Strict launch vehicle mass envelope ceiling for deep space electric propulsion.

C05_shutdown_margin_all_in.source: NASA / KAPL-4849 Aerospace Reactor Flight Safety Standard
C05_shutdown_margin_all_in.description: Requires deep subcriticality during launch, ascent, and inadvertent water immersion.

C06_shutdown_margin_stuck.description: Ensures subcriticality even if the highest-worth drum jams fully withdrawn.

C07_operating_keff.source: Burnup Depletion Reserve Criterion (20+ years at 68.2 pcm/year)
C07_operating_keff.description: Ensures excess reactivity > 1200 pcm for multi-decade NEP flight lifetime.

C08_enrichment_ceiling.source: Strict Non-Proliferation / HALEU Commercial Licensing Standard
C08_enrichment_ceiling.description: Must not exceed 19.75 wt% under any optimization state.

C09_geometric_feasibility.description: Requires fuel_radius + clad_th + gap < pitch/sqrt(3) and positive flow areas.

F1_subassembly_mass.name: Minimize Core Subassembly Mass
F1_subassembly_mass.description: Reduces launch mass and spacecraft inertia.

F2_peak_cladding_temp.name: Minimize Peak Cladding Temperature
F2_peak_cladding_temp.description: Expands thermal creep margin below the 1350 K limit.

F3_core_pressure_drop.name: Minimize Core Total Pressure Drop
F3_core_pressure_drop.description: Maximizes Brayton cycle efficiency and reduces compressor power.

F4_radial_power_peaking.name: Minimize Total 3D Power Peaking
F4_radial_power_peaking.description: Flattens core power profile and eliminates localized thermal hotspots.

F5_hot_channel_elevation.name: Minimize Hot-Channel Outlet Elevation
F5_hot_channel_elevation.description: T_cool,exit,max - T_cool,bulk,out. Eliminates thermal striping into turbine.
